verdict.rationale: Galileo ships a documented Python SDK (with decorators like `@log`), an sdk-api docs section, OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing, and an official MCP server for creating datasets, running experiments, and managing prompts programmatically — all clear entry points for an AI-native/agentic user to drive Galileo without the UI. However, a probe for a formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec returned 404 on all standard paths, indicating no discoverable public REST API contract, only SDK/MCP-based access. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST API reference, independent confirmation of API completeness beyond SDK wrappers.
